Abdulsaid was involved in fifteen [[Decapitation|beheadings]] as well as in attacks against security forces. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornado outbreak sequence of April 25–28, 2024]]
**A [[tornado outbreak]] in areas near [[Omaha]], [[Nebraska]], [[United States]], leads to the issuance of multiple [[Tornado emergency|tornado emergencies]] across the states of [[Nebraska]] and [[Iowa]]. [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/us/us-news/tornado-emergency-warning-issued-for-omaha-nebraska-missouri-valley-iowa-what-it-means-article-109634024 (Times Now)] [https://twitter.com/NWSOmaha/status/1783990734812790788 (National Weather Service)]
**A [[Doppler on Wheels]] unit records wind speeds of 224 miles / 360 kilometers per hour in a tornado near [[Harlan, Iowa]], the strongest recorded by a mobile [[Weather radar|weather radar]] since the [[2013 El Reno tornado]], equivalent to EF-5 intensity on the [[Enhanced Fujita scale]]. [https://twitter.com/DOWFacility/status/1784622447116869742 (University of Illinois)]
